Aeroblast
moves.description:
Activation Condition:
When the user’s [Name:ReferencedMessageTag ] is increased.
Deactivation Condition:
When the user’s [Name:ReferencedMessageTag ] is not increased.

Never misses. Except in certain circumstances, successful hits with this attack become critical hits. This attack’s power increases 50% when the target is affected by a status condition. Makes the target flinch.

moves.description: Applies the Enduring effect to the user. The more the user’s [Name:ReferencedMessageTag ] is increased, the more it reduces its sync move countdown (can be reduced by up to [Digit:1digit Idx="1" ] maximum).

passives.name: Sky Myth
passives.description: Powers up the moves of all allied sync pairs by [Digit:2digits ]%. Reduces attack move damage taken by all allied sync pairs by [Digit:2digits Idx="1" ]%. The more allied sync pairs with [Name:ReferencedMessageTag Idx="2" ] you have on your team, the higher these percentages are. (Each additional sync pair powers up moves by 10% and reduces damage by 3%. The maximum power-up is [Digit:2digits Idx="3" ]%, and the maximum damage reduction is [Digit:2digits Idx="4" ]%.)

passives.name: Sky Judgment
passives.description: Raises the [Name:ReferencedMessageTag ] of all allied sync pairs by [Digit:1digit Idx="1" ] [EN:Qty Ref="1" S="rank" P="ranks" ] the first time the user enters a battle each battle. Lowers the [Name:ReferencedMessageTag ] of all opposing sync pairs by [Digit:1digit Idx="1" ] [EN:Qty Ref="1" S="rank" P="ranks" ] the first time the user enters a battle each battle.

passives.name: Shining Silver Soul
passives.description: Turns the field of play’s zone into an [Name:ReferencedMessageTag ] the first time the user’s attack move is successful each battle. (An [Name:ReferencedMessageTag ] powers up [Name:ReferencedMessageTag Idx="1" ]-type attacks.) Increases the user’s [Name:ReferencedMessageTag Idx="2" ] by [Digit:1digit Idx="3" ] [EN:Qty Ref="3" S="rank" P="ranks" ] when its Pokémon uses a move. Lowers the target’s [Name:ReferencedMessageTag Idx="4" ] by [Digit:1digit Idx="5" ] stat [EN:Qty Ref="5" S="rank" P="ranks" ] when the user’s attack move against it is successful.
